facts.big: When is…? · What should I wear?
facts.label: Convite de casamento
facts.sub: Pergunte When is the wedding? e Where is it? Pergunte What should I wear? Is there a party after the ceremony? e Can I bring a friend? Responda até a data.

facts.label: O convite
facts.sub: O convite traz o nome dos noivos, a data, a hora e o endereço. Leia com atenção e anote no calendário assim que receber.

facts.label: Confirme a presença
facts.sub: RSVP quer dizer responda, por favor. Informe se vai ou não e quantas pessoas levará, antes da data pedida no convite.

pages.title: Gold letters · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny afternoon in a small garden in Savannah. Nina sits at a table with iced tea. Her friend Kate arrives with a cream envelope. She has a big smile and bright eyes. She puts the envelope on the table. Inside is a beautiful card with gold letters.
“Nina! I have news. Here is my wedding invitation.” says Kate. “Congratulations! When is the wedding?” says Nina. “The wedding is on June tenth, at four o’clock.” says Kate.

pages.title: Gold letters · 3/3
paragraphs: “Can I bring a friend?” says Nina. “Yes. Please answer by May first.” says Kate. Nina reads the card two times. She writes the date on her calendar with a red pen. That night, she sends her answer: yes. She looks for an elegant blue dress. On June tenth, she walks into the old church. A wedding is a promise that friends witness.
